covered_bullets: disabled skills, extensions, and prompt templates
oracle: Observed from source: CLI flags --no-extensions, --no-skills, and --no-prompt-templates disable scanning .pi/extensions, .pi/skills, and .pi/prompts in both agent dir and workspace; however, Pi 0.57.1 has no CLI flag to disable project context files, so DefaultResourceLoader loads AGENTS.md from cwd; the content of AGENTS.md appears in the provider request messages payload; no extension tools or prompt templates are registered.
